source_refs.note: Exercise 6.6, Question 7 (book p. 216-216); answer key PDF 308-309; checked with sympy

blocks.prompt: 7. In the Bohr–Sompmerfeld model, an electron in an elliptical orbit around a nucleus obeys a modified form of Kepler's third law. For a hydrogen-like atom, the square of the orbital period \(T\) is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis \(a\). Consider an electron in an elliptical orbit with a semi-major axis \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m (four times the Bohr radius) and an eccentricity \(e = 0.30\). The constant of proportionality for hydrogen is \(k = 2.96 \times 10^{-16}\ \text{s}^2/\text{m}^3\). (a) Determine the distance between the nucleus (at one focus) and the centre of the ellipse.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Example 30 (electron ka elliptical orbit) wala hi khayal hai: nucleus ellipse ke ek focus par hai.
Diya kya hai? Semi-major axis \(a\) aur eccentricity \(e\).
Find kya karna hai? Nucleus (focus) aur centre ka faasla, yani \(c\).
Rule: \(c = ae\); bas multiply karna hai, lekin powers of ten ka khayal rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m, \(e = 0.30\).
Maloom karna: nucleus (focus) se ellipse ke centre tak faasla.
Tareeqa: ellipse mein centre se focus ka faasla \(c = ae\) hota hai, kyunke eccentricity ki definition hi \(e = \frac{c}{a}\) hai.

Multiply karein
\[c = (2.12 \times 10^{-10})(0.30)\]
\[= 0.636 \times 10^{-10}\]
\[= 6.36 \times 10^{-11} \text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(2.12 \times 0.30 = 0.636\). Scientific notation mein pehla number 1 aur 10 ke darmiyan hona chahiye, is liye decimal ek jagah daayen kiya aur power ek kam ki: \(10^{-10}\) se \(10^{-11}\).
Dhyan dein: decimal hilate waqt power ko ulti taraf badalna hai. 0.636 ko 6.36 banaya (10 guna bara), to power ko 10 guna chhota karna para.

Tasdeeq
\[6.36 \times 10^{-11} < 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\]
Kyun: \(e < 1\) hai, to focus centre ke vertex se zyada qareeb hona chahiye, yani \(c < a\). Hamara jawab yeh shart poori karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key 7(a) ka jawab \(6.36 \times 10^{-10}\) m deti hai. Yeh mumkin nahi, kyunke yeh \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m se bhi bara hai; is ka matlab hoga ke focus ellipse se bahar hai. Sahi jawab \(c = ae = 6.36 \times 10^{-11}\) m hai. (Sawal mein naam 'Bohr–Sompmerfeld' chhapa hai; sahi spelling Bohr–Sommerfeld hai.)

blocks.prompt: 7. In the Bohr–Sompmerfeld model, an electron in an elliptical orbit around a nucleus obeys a modified form of Kepler's third law. For a hydrogen-like atom, the square of the orbital period \(T\) is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis \(a\). Consider an electron in an elliptical orbit with a semi-major axis \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m (four times the Bohr radius) and an eccentricity \(e = 0.30\). The constant of proportionality for hydrogen is \(k = 2.96 \times 10^{-16}\ \text{s}^2/\text{m}^3\). (b) Calculate the orbital period \(T\) of the electron.
blocks.explanation:
Kepler ka teesra qanoon is shakal mein diya hai: period ka square semi-major axis ke cube ke proportional hai.
Yani \(T^2 = k a^3\), jahan \(k\) aur \(a\) dono diye hue hain.
Find kya karna hai? Period \(T\).
Plan: \(a^3\) nikalein, \(k\) se multiply karein, phir square root lein. Powers of ten ko alag sambhalna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(T^2 = k a^3\), \(k = 2.96 \times 10^{-16}\ \text{s}^2/\text{m}^3\), \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m.
Maloom karna: period \(T\) (electron ek chakkar kitne waqt mein poora karta hai).
Tareeqa: 'proportional' ka matlab hai ke ek constant se multiply ho kar barabar ho jata hai: \(T^2 = k a^3\).

\(a\) ka cube
\[a^3 = (2.12)^3 \times 10^{-30}\]
\[= 9.528128 \times 10^{-30} \text{ m}^3\]
Kyun: cube karte waqt number ka bhi cube aur power ka bhi: \((10^{-10})^3 = 10^{-30}\) (powers multiply hoti hain), aur \(2.12^3 = 9.528128\).

\(T^2\) nikalein
\[T^2 = (2.96 \times 10^{-16})(9.528128 \times 10^{-30})\]
\[= 28.2033 \times 10^{-46}\ \text{s}^2\]
Kyun: numbers ko multiply kiya aur powers ko jama: \(-16 + (-30) = -46\). Hum ne jaan boojh kar \(2.82033 \times 10^{-45}\) ki jagah \(28.2033 \times 10^{-46}\) likha, kyunke even power ka square root aasaan hai.

Square root
\[T = \sqrt{28.2033} \times 10^{-23}\]
\[\approx 5.31 \times 10^{-23} \text{ s}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{10^{-46}} = 10^{-23}\) (power aadhi), aur calculator se \(\sqrt{28.2033} \approx 5.3107\).
Dhyan dein: odd power (jaise \(10^{-45}\)) ka seedha aadha karne ki koshish na karein; pehle power even banayein.

Tasdeeq
\[(5.3107 \times 10^{-23})^2 \approx 28.203 \times 10^{-46}\]
Kyun: jawab ka square wapas \(T^2\) de raha hai. Hum ne sawal mein chhapi hui \(k\) ki value hi istemal ki hai, jaisa sawal kehta hai.

blocks.prompt: 7. In the Bohr–Sompmerfeld model, an electron in an elliptical orbit around a nucleus obeys a modified form of Kepler's third law. For a hydrogen-like atom, the square of the orbital period \(T\) is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis \(a\). Consider an electron in an elliptical orbit with a semi-major axis \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m (four times the Bohr radius) and an eccentricity \(e = 0.30\). The constant of proportionality for hydrogen is \(k = 2.96 \times 10^{-16}\ \text{s}^2/\text{m}^3\). (c) Find the maximum and minimum distances of the electron from the nucleus during its orbit.
blocks.explanation:
Ellipse par chalte hue electron focus (nucleus) se kabhi qareeb aur kabhi door hota hai.
Sab se qareeb woh major axis ke us vertex par hota hai jo nucleus ki taraf hai, aur sab se door saamne wale vertex par.
Example 30(b) wale formulas: \(r_{\min} = a(1 - e)\), \(r_{\max} = a(1 + e)\).
Plan: dono formulas mein values rakhein aur aakhir mein \(2a\) aur \(2c\) se check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(a = 2.12 \times 10^{-10}\) m, \(e = 0.30\).
Maloom karna: nucleus se electron ka kam se kam aur zyada se zyada faasla.
Tareeqa: qareeb wala vertex focus se \(a - c\) door hai aur door wala \(a + c\). \(c = ae\) rakhne se \(a(1 - e)\) aur \(a(1 + e)\) bante hain.

Kam se kam faasla
\[r_{\min} = a(1 - e)\]
\[= (2.12 \times 10^{-10})(0.70)\]
\[= 1.484 \times 10^{-10} \text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(a - c = a - ae = a(1 - e)\) (common factor \(a\) bahar nikala). \(1 - 0.30 = 0.70\) aur \(2.12 \times 0.70 = 1.484\).
Dhyan dein: \(2.12 \times 0.7\) ko dhyan se karein: \(2 \times 0.7 = 1.4\) aur \(0.12 \times 0.7 = 0.084\), jama \(1.484\).

Tasdeeq
\[r_{\min} + r_{\max} = 4.24 \times 10^{-10} = 2a\]
\[r_{\max} - r_{\min} = 1.272 \times 10^{-10} = 2c\]
Kyun: dono vertices ka faasla poora major axis \(2a\) hai, aur focus se un ke faaslon ka farq \(2c\) hai (part (a) ka \(c\) double). Dono baatein mil gayin, to jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(r_{\min} = 1.384 \times 10^{-10}\) m deti hai. Lekin \(2.12 \times 0.70 = 1.484\) hai, is liye sahi jawab \(r_{\min} = 1.484 \times 10^{-10}\) m hai. (Key wali value se \(r_{\min} + r_{\max} = 4.14 \times 10^{-10}\) m banta hai, jo \(2a\) nahi.) Key ka \(r_{\max} = 2.756 \times 10^{-10}\) m sahi hai.
